name: Unidentified planet
description: A red planet was located near the Rikmania system in the Steniplis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. While running a job for Jabba Desilijic Tiure, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca crashed their freighter the Millennium Falcon on the planet after running an Imperial blockade, and discovered a shipyard run by Rekias Nodo.
